historical_reviews.v3_1: Vendor binary provenance and Project topology are finite readiness inputs; software substitution or injected-error evidence cannot replace the specified status read.

original_test_intent: Read the actual WAFL link state for every target GPU and verify each GPU exposes exactly two intended WAFL links at 2 GT/s with width 1, without changing link or RAS state.
original_method: Validate the AMDXIO executable and GPU-to-WAFL topology, run the source command once through protected access, retain complete stdout/stderr and exit status, parse every GPU/link record and compare each field with the Project matrix.
manual_activity: The platform owner supplies and approves the AMDXIO binary, supported firmware scope and expected GPU/WAFL mapping; a human resolves unsupported or ambiguous link labels.
required_inputs: Exact SUT GPU count, UUID/BDF/OAM mapping and driver/firmware versions
Vendor-approved AMDXIO binary, version, checksum and supported invocation
Expected two-link-per-GPU matrix and exact 2 GT/s/width-1 encoding
Protected privilege elevation and evidence storage
Parser rules for missing, disabled, degraded or unexpected links
safety_requirements: Keep execution strictly read-only and preserve pre-existing logs
Do not run amdgpuras, inject SDMA or any other fault, retrieve CPER as acceptance, retrain links, reset GPUs or write link configuration
Verify AMDXIO provenance before privileged execution
Use trusted host identity and credential handling; no sshpass or host-key bypass
Stop on unsupported binary, malformed output, topology ambiguity or unexpected state change
Retain complete raw output rather than a filtered tail
agent_execution_scope: Verify GPU identities, topology, AMDXIO hash/version and expected matrix
Execute only `amdxio -wafl -linkstatus` in the approved directory
Collect full output and exit status and map every returned link to its GPU
Report count/speed/width differences and relevant existing events
Do not mutate GPU/link state or decide the final verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the tool and WAFL topology/schema
Resolve mapping or speed/width representation ambiguities
Review comparison evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `./amdxio -wafl -linkstatus` is source-aligned, but the wrapper uses unsafe SSH identity/secret handling and the proposed amdgpuras injection, dmesg hardware-error and CPER evidence belong exclusively to duplicate row 2079.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the verified vendor binary as `sudo ./amdxio -wafl -linkstatus`, capturing unfiltered stdout/stderr and exit status; perform only approved read-only inventory cross-checks.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Two links per GPU, 2 GT/s, width 1, the exact `-wafl -linkstatus` operation and 5/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind every GPU and expected link, verify the AMDXIO artifact, execute one read-only status query and compare a lossless per-link parse with the Project matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds binary provenance, stable GPU/link identity, complete parsing and explicit no-mutation/no-injection boundaries.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: CPER, RAS injection or generic PCIe output cannot substitute for AMDXIO WAFL count/speed/width evidence; optional cross-checks are supporting only.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A privileged unverified vendor utility may be incompatible or mislabel links, and tool-reported IDs require a Project mapping to physical GPUs/OAMs.

project_override_considerations: If platform firmware legitimately reports a different negotiated speed, width or link count, Project SPEC must provide the per-GPU exception and its engineering rationale; the Review must not normalize it to the hard-coded source values silently.
expected_evidence: SUT/GPU UUID-BDF-OAM identity, driver/firmware versions and approved WAFL topology matrix
AMDXIO version/checksum/provenance and protected execution context
Complete raw stdout/stderr and exit status from the exact status command
Parsed GPU/link identifier, count, state, speed and width for every GPU
Read-only GPU/PCIe baseline and relevant pre-existing log comparison
Mismatch/unsupported-output report, no-injection/no-mutation audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1530's Items, command and Criteria consistently describe a read-only WAFL status query. The same-code row 2079 and copied DeepSeek RAS evidence are disambiguated association defects, not a contradiction inside this Master row.

blocked_analysis.analysis: AMDXIO provenance, topology and output semantics are identifiable vendor/Project inputs. Until supplied execution is not ready, but the operation and acceptance are clear.

review_improvement: Removes a destructive SDMA-injection overlay from a read-only link check and defines the exact AMDXIO artifact, identity mapping and complete per-link evidence needed to audit the hard-coded link expectations.
independent_technical_reasoning: WAFL status is a topology claim: aggregate success text is insufficient because one missing link on one GPU can coexist with valid records elsewhere. The correct unit of evidence is each stable GPU/link tuple, whereas a generated CPER demonstrates an injected RAS path and says nothing about the required negotiated WAFL width and speed.
